Get your comprehensive vehicle history report in just a few simple steps

Enter Your VIN

Frequently Asked Questions

Everything you need to know about VIN checks and vehicle history reports

1

What is a VIN (Vehicle Identification Number)?

A VIN is a unique 17-character code assigned to every vehicle manufactured since 1981. It's like a fingerprint for your car, containing information about the manufacturer, model year, place of manufacture, and unique serial number. You can find it on your vehicle's dashboard (visible through the windshield), driver's side door jamb, registration documents, or insurance papers.

2

Where do I find my vehicle's VIN?

The VIN can be found in several locations: on the dashboard near the windshield on the driver's side (visible from outside), on the driver's side door jamb sticker, on your vehicle registration card (Mulkiya) in the UAE, on your insurance documents, under the hood on the engine block, and on the vehicle title or purchase documents. The VIN is always 17 characters long and contains both numbers and letters (excluding I, O, and Q to avoid confusion).

3

What databases do you check?

We search comprehensive databases including UAE Ministry of Interior (MOI) vehicle records, US auction databases (Copart and IAAI), National Motor Vehicle Title Information System (NMVTIS), manufacturer recall databases, theft records from international agencies, insurance claim histories, odometer fraud databases, and title brand information. This multi-source approach ensures you get the most complete vehicle history available.

4

Is the VIN check really free?

Yes! We offer a free basic VIN check that includes essential information such as vehicle specifications and basic history overview in order to highlight any outstanding issues. This helps you make an informed initial assessment of any vehicle. For buyers who need more detailed information, we offer a premium report that includes comprehensive accident history, auction records, and full recalls details.

5

How accurate is the vehicle history data?

Our data comes directly from official government databases, insurance companies, auction houses, and manufacturer records, ensuring high accuracy. However, it's important to note that the report is only as complete as the data reported to these databases. Some incidents may not be reported, especially minor accidents settled privately or repairs done without insurance claims. We always recommend combining our report with a professional mechanical inspection before purchasing any used vehicle.

6

How long does it take to get my report?

Your vehicle history report is generated within 60-90 seconds. Once you enter a valid VIN and submit your request, our system searches multiple databases simultaneously and compiles your comprehensive report. The slight delay is due to captcha verification required by some government databases. You'll be able to view your report immediately after processing completes.

7

Can I check vehicles imported from the USA?

Absolutely! In fact, this is one of our specialties. Many vehicles in the UAE are imported from the United States, and our system provides extensive US history including auction records from Copart and IAAI (including photos of the vehicle at auction), title history from all 50 states, flood damage records, theft records, and detailed accident reports. This is crucial for UAE buyers since many US vehicles are sold at auction after accidents or flood damage.

8

What if the VIN shows no records?

If a VIN shows no records, it could mean several things: the vehicle is very new and records haven't been updated yet, the vehicle has never been in an accident or reported incident (which is good news), the vehicle was manufactured outside major markets and has limited database coverage, or there may be an error in the VIN entered. We recommend double-checking the VIN for accuracy and trying again. A clean report doesn't guarantee a problem-free vehicle, so always get a professional inspection.

9

Do you show accident photos and damage details?

When available, we retrieve photos directly from official UAE accident reports. For vehicles that have appeared in US auctions (Copart, IAAI), auction photos showing the vehicle's condition at the time of sale are also included. Photo access is part of our paid report — not all vehicles will have photos, but when they exist, they're included automatically.

10

Is my search confidential and secure?

Absolutely. We take your privacy seriously. All VIN searches are encrypted using industry-standard SSL technology, we don't share your search history with third parties, no personal information is required for basic searches, and your data is stored securely and never sold to marketers or dealers. You can search with complete confidence knowing your information is protected and your vehicle research remains private.

A MiTM attacker having access to victim's traffic at the TCP/IP layer can redirect traffic from one subdomain to another, resulting in a valid TLS session.
